title: Contains Duplicate
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return `false` if every element is distinct.

Aim for an `O(n)` average-time algorithm using a hash set.
hints: A brute-force check compares every pair of elements in O(n^2) time, or sorts a copy in O(n log n) time to inspect adjacent elements.
Maintain a hash set of values seen so far while scanning left to right.
If the current element is already in the set, return true immediately; otherwise insert it and continue.

examples.explanation: The value 1 appears at indices 0 and 3, so return true.
All four elements are distinct, so return false.
Several values (1, 2, 3, and 4) appear more than once, so return true.
